nodes.label: Dummy-Data-Only Frontend Phase
nodes.rationale: No backend features, DB schema, or real auth yet; the whole app is driven from resources/js/data so UX and design can be verified before persistence exists.

nodes.label: Vue 3 <script setup> SPA mounted on Blade #app

nodes.label: Module-Level Singleton Composables
nodes.rationale: State is module-level (singleton) on purpose: one facilities array must feed map, card list, and admin dashboard from the same source instead of per-component copies.

nodes.label: meta.js as Single Source for Status Labels and Glyphs
nodes.rationale: Statuses are added centrally in meta.js, never inline in components, so label/glyph pairs cannot drift between dashboard, cards, and map.
nodes.norm_label: meta.js as single source for status labels and glyphs

nodes.label: StatusPill: Label + Glyph, Never Colour Alone
nodes.rationale: Colour-only status encoding fails for colour-blind and screen-reader users, so verification state always carries a text label and a glyph.
nodes.norm_label: statuspill: label + glyph, never colour alone

nodes.label: Rust as Sole Accent, Kept Off Small Text on Ink
nodes.rationale: --rust is the only accent colour; on --ink backgrounds it must not be used for small text because the pair does not meet contrast.
nodes.norm_label: rust as sole accent, kept off small text on ink

nodes.label: Leaflet L.divIcon Square Markers (no image assets)
nodes.norm_label: leaflet l.divicon square markers (no image assets)

nodes.label: Card List as the Keyboard/Screen-Reader Path to the Map
nodes.rationale: An interactive Leaflet map is not keyboard- or screen-reader-navigable, so the same facilities array is rendered as a focusable card list.
nodes.norm_label: card list as the keyboard/screen-reader path to the map

nodes.label: Design Tokens and Component Classes in resources/css/app.css
nodes.rationale: Class-based CSS rather than Tailwind utilities; Tailwind 4 is wired up but there is no tailwind.config.js.
nodes.norm_label: design tokens and component classes in resources/css/app.css

nodes.label: bunny() Font Download at Build Time
nodes.rationale: Fonts are self-hosted instead of using the prototype's Google Fonts <link>, so a build without network access fails.
nodes.norm_label: bunny() font download at build time

nodes.label: TemplateDesignWeb as Read-Only Design Reference
nodes.rationale: The bundle is a design reference, not production code: adapt from it, never edit or delete it.

nodes.label: SPA Fallback {any} with /up Excluded
nodes.rationale: The catch-all route must not swallow /up, otherwise Laravel's container health check breaks.

nodes.label: MySQL in .env vs SQLite :memory: in phpunit.xml
nodes.rationale: Tests run on throwaway in-memory SQLite, so migrations must stay portable and must never touch Laragon's local MySQL data.
nodes.norm_label: mysql in .env vs sqlite :memory: in phpunit.xml

nodes.label: Only Three Quality Gates (no CI, no static analysis)
nodes.rationale: With no CI and no JS test runner, php artisan test, pint --test, and a successful npm run build are the entire verification surface.
nodes.norm_label: only three quality gates (no ci, no static analysis)

nodes.label: Laravel Framework (default scaffold README)
nodes.rationale: This README is Laravel's unmodified boilerplate — it documents the framework, not AksesKita; project guidance lives in AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Filmstrip / ProjectStrip (horizontal scroll-snap gallery)
nodes.rationale: The page's core idea is direction — work is 'walked through sideways', and the filmstrip is the primary browsing gesture rather than a portfolio grid.

nodes.label: Atelier Tide Design Tokens (paper / ink / rust)
nodes.rationale: Six colour tokens (paper, ink, rust, warm, ink-muted, body) plus supporting ink alphas; tokens are the portable part of the bundle, the single-file <style> block is not.
nodes.norm_label: atelier tide design tokens (paper / ink / rust)

nodes.label: Single Accent Hue Rule
nodes.rationale: There is exactly one accent hue; introducing a second would dissolve the restraint that is the design.

nodes.label: Zero Border Radius Rule
nodes.rationale: Cards, buttons, images, badges and inputs are hard-edged; only the scrollbar thumb and timeline dots are round, so adding radius during implementation breaks the system.

nodes.label: Hard 24px Rust Offset Shadow (hero image only)
nodes.rationale: One shadow in the whole design: box-shadow 24px 24px 0 #a8542a, zero blur. Everything else separates with 1px borders and flat background shifts.
nodes.norm_label: hard 24px rust offset shadow (hero image only)

nodes.label: Syne / Inter / DM Mono Type Triad
nodes.norm_label: syne / inter / dm mono type triad

nodes.label: Scroll Reveal (.reveal + one-shot IntersectionObserver)
nodes.rationale: Fade-and-rise over 0.8s is one-shot (class .in is never removed) so the page feels slow and deliberate; the prototype does not honour prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: High-Fidelity Handoff: Recreate, Do Not Copy
nodes.rationale: Carry over the visual system, layout, copy and behaviour; leave behind the single-file <style> block, global selectors, inline background-image URLs and the Google Fonts <link>, rebuilding inside the target codebase's own primitives.
nodes.norm_label: high-fidelity handoff: recreate, do not copy

nodes.label: Build Checklist / Known Gaps
nodes.rationale: The prototype ships four must-fix gaps — no mobile nav below 880px, no :focus-visible styles, no prefers-reduced-motion path, no scroll-margin-top under the fixed header.

nodes.label: Strip Prev/Next scrollBy(±500) Handlers
nodes.rationale: 500px is roughly one card (460px) plus its gap (24px), so the step is hard-coded to 'advance one card' and breaks at the 88vw mobile card width.

nodes.label: TemplateDesignWeb Root Prototype (byte-identical copy)
nodes.rationale: Same bytes as design_handoff_atelier_tide/index.html (MD5 AD671CEE36B3FE164616F9B8F9E3A40F); kept at the bundle root as the preview entry point.

nodes.label: robots.txt Allow-All (Laravel default)
nodes.rationale: User-agent: * with an empty Disallow permits every crawler; the file is Laravel's shipped default and has not been tailored to the app.
